node.statement: Choose e_1 so that ||A^2-I||<1/2. In the associative operator algebra, B:=(A^2)^(-1/2) is defined by its convergent power series and ||B||<=C_B. The same series, termwise factored at 1, gives B-I=(A^2-I)K(A^2) with ||K(A^2)||<=C_K. Since A commutes with B and K(A^2), theta(A)-I=(AB-I)/2=(A-I)H(A), where H(A)=[B+(A+I)K(A^2)]/2 and ||H(A)||<=C_H. Consequently ||(theta(A)-I)Q||=||H(A)(A-I)Q||<=C_H C_Q e. Taking K_1=C_H C_Q proves the amended node, and Co_Q(Q)=tilde Q=u_Q is the registered column-inner-product identification.
